title: 第3212章 重回天宫秘境第3211章 还是暴露了
slug: 开局长生不死谁都以为我无敌
lines: 难怪圣巫一族这些人表情都这么凝重，合着是身份暴露了？
不过，这好端端的身份是怎么暴露的？
“卧槽，不会是因为我们这一次去天宫秘境才暴露的吧？”陈长安皱着眉头说道。
“你们出去被人发现了？”公墟惊讶的问道。
“被发现了，但是我们将那些人都杀了。”
“不过，有人发现跟了过来，恐怕也有人发现了但并没有声张，而是私底下偷偷的泄露消息了。”
“这也是为什么，现在会流传圣巫一族出现了，却没有人知道你们在什么地方。”
“只是没想到，我们当时也算是比较低调了，竟然还是会被发现。”
“看来有些事情，瞒是瞒不住的。”
“事已至此，现在想那么多也没用。”
“当务之急，就是提升实力，提升修为。”
听到陈长安的话，公墟点了点头，随后问道“可他们这么寻找的话，只怕是早晚都会找到这里，这会影响到我们的修炼啊。”
“这确实是一个问题，但我有一个好去处。”
“天宫秘境，你们觉得怎么样？”
天宫秘境？
“天宫秘境那么危险，我们……”
“危险什么？我们不是好好的回来了吗？”
“听我的没错，天宫秘境的环境比这里好，修炼起来事半功倍。”
“而且前面的路，我们已经探明白了，资源用的差不多了，随时都可以去取，这不是更方便？”
“况且这个地方更加的隐秘，可以给我们充足的时间修炼。”
听到陈长安这么说，公墟犹豫了片刻之后，这才点了点头。
“这么多人一起行动，确实是容易引起别人的窥探。”
“你们圣巫一族有没有……算了，我自己就有。”
“咱们直接用星船吧，一次性过去，尽量不引起太多人的关注。”
星船？
“你想没想过，你用星船更引人注意。”
“一般情况下，并没有多少人会选择，用星船这种东西当做飞行工具。”
“只有在无尽星河之中，才会选择星船。”
听到公墟的话，陈长安笑着说道“没有多少人选择，不意味着所有人都不选择。”
“难不成分批次的走？上一次我们去天宫秘境的人数可并不多，不还是引起了注意。”
“总不能一个一个的去吧？那得需要多久时间。”
“听我的，就用星船。”
“那我去找族人们说一下。”
“嗯，去吧。”
公墟离开之后，牧云谣饶有兴致的看向陈长安，笑着问道“去天宫秘境，这应该不是你临时起意吧？”
“是不是就算圣巫一族没有暴露，你也这么打算的？”
“所以当初你才走的那么痛快？”
“早就有这种打算了？”
听到牧云谣的话，陈长安笑着点了点头，他确实是一直都有这个打算。
“天宫秘境确实是最安全的地方，而且也更适合大家修炼。”
“我没有急着去后面，就是想着，大家先修炼，提升实力之后，一步一步的试探。”
content_en:
;;
No wonder the faces of the Holy Witch Clan are so solemn. Has their identity been exposed?
However, how did this good identity come to light?
"Damn it, it couldn't have been exposed because we went to the secret realm of Tiangong this time, right?" Chen Changan said with a frown.
"What?"
"You were discovered when you went out?" Gongxu asked in surprise.
"We were discovered, but we killed all those people."
"However, some people discovered it and followed it. I'm afraid there were also people who discovered it but didn't make it public. Instead, they secretly leaked the news privately."
"This is why there are rumors that the Holy Witch Clan has appeared, but no one knows where you are."
"I just didn't expect that we would still be discovered despite being relatively low-key at the time."
"It seems that there are some things that cannot be hidden."
"The matter has come to an end. It's useless to think about it now."
"The top priority is to improve our strength and cultivation."
Hearing Chen Changan's words, Gongxu nodded, and then asked, "But if they search like this, they will find it here sooner or later, which will affect our cultivation."
"It's definitely a problem, but I have a good place to be."
"What do you think of the secret realm of Heavenly Palace?"
The secret realm of Heavenly Palace?
"The secret realm of Heavenly Palace is so dangerous, we..."
"What's the danger? Didn't we come back well?"
"Listen to me, you are right. The environment in the secret realm of Tiangong is better than here. You can practice with twice the result with half the effort."
"And we have figured out the road ahead. We have almost used the resources and can get them at any time. Isn't this more convenient?"
"Besides, this place is more secretive and can give us enough time to practice."
Hearing what Chen Changan said, Gongxu hesitated for a moment and then nodded.
"With so many people acting together, it is indeed easy for others to spy on you."
"Do you, the Holy Witch Clan, have any...forget it, I have one myself."
"Let's just use the starship and go there at once, trying not to attract too many people's attention."
Starship?
"Have you ever thought about it, you use a starship to attract more attention."
"Normally, not many people would choose to use something like a starship as a flying tool."
"Only in the endless galaxy, would you choose a starship."
Hearing Gongxu's words, Chen Changan smiled and said, "Not many people choose, but it doesn't mean that everyone doesn't choose."
"Is it possible to leave in batches? The last time we went to the Tiangong Secret Realm, there were not many people, but it still attracted attention."
"We can't go one by one, right? How long will it take?"
"Listen to me and use the starship."
"That's...ok."
"Then I'll go talk to the clansmen."
"Well, go ahead."
After Gongxu left, Mu Yunyao looked at Chen Changan with great interest and asked with a smile, "Going to the secret realm of Tiangong, isn't this your last-minute idea?"
"Is this what you planned even if the Holy Witch clan was not exposed?"
"Is that why you left so happily?"
"Have you had such a plan for a long time?"
Hearing Mu Yunyao's words, Chen Changan smiled and nodded. He had indeed always had this plan.
"The Secret Realm of Heavenly Palace is indeed the safest place, and it is also more suitable for everyone to practice."
"I'm not in a hurry to go to the back. I just want everyone to practice first and test it step by step after improving their strength."
title_en: Chapter 3212 Return to the Secret Realm of Heavenly Palace Chapter 3211 Still Exposed
